record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: Tame(3) and action on the CAT(0) complex
record.original_question: Can one characterize the elements f in Tame(3) with λ(f)=1 in terms of their action on the CAT(0) complex C constructed for Tame(3)?

evidence.quote: Question 41. — Is it possible to characterize those f ∈ Tame(3) for which λ(f) = 1 in terms of their action on C?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Tame}(3) \subset \mathrm{Aut}(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the tame subgroup of polynomial automorphisms of three-dimensional affine space, i.e.\ the subgroup generated by the affine group $\mathrm{Aff}_3$ and the elementary subgroup consisting of automorphisms of the form $(x_1,x_2,x_3)\mapsto(x_1+P(x_2,x_3),x_2,x_3)$ together with permutations of coordinates. For $f \in \mathrm{Tame}(3)$, let $\lambda(f) := \lim_{n\to\infty}(\deg f^n)^{1/n}$ denote the (first) dynamical degree of $f$, where $\deg$ is the maximum of the degrees of the polynomial components. Let $\mathcal{C}$ denote the two-dimensional CAT(0) simplicial (square) complex on which $\mathrm{Tame}(3)$ acts naturally (a higher-dimensional analogue of the Bass–Serre tree, with vertices indexed by certain equivalence classes of tame triples / coordinate systems, on which $\mathrm{Tame}(3)$ acts by isometries).

Problem: Characterize, purely in terms of the isometric action of $f$ on $\mathcal{C}$ (e.g.\ whether $f$ is elliptic, parabolic, or loxodromic, the structure of its fixed-point set, minimal displacement, translation length, etc.), exactly those elements $f \in \mathrm{Tame}(3)$ which satisfy $\lambda(f)=1$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a recent list of open problems on Hénon maps and related topics. Related results by Bisi, Furter and Lamy construct a CAT(0) hyperbolic square complex on which Tame(SL_2) (the analogous tame group of an affine quadric threefold) acts, and recent work shows tame dynamical degrees avoid the interval (1,4), but no published characterization of $\lambda(f)=1$ in Tame(3) via the action on $\mathcal{C}$ was found.

status_evidence.title: The tame automorphism group of an affine quadric threefold acting on a square complex
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a CAT(0) hyperbolic square complex on which Tame(SL_2) acts cocompactly.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational construction of the CAT(0) complex referenced in the question; no characterization of λ=1 elements is given there.

status_evidence.title: Algebra & Number Theory Vol. 18 (2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Dynamical degrees of tame elements avoid values strictly between 1 and 4.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress on dynamical degrees of tame automorphisms, but does not give a CAT(0)-action characterization of λ(f)=1.
